notes.title: Ninja and Archangel! - v1.05 - 21/12/2017
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31178570/24480157c2147d6f30233622b4874f1d8b5a1c0d.gif[/img]
Added 2 new Units, [b]Ninja and Archangel.[/b]

 * [b]Ninja[/b] - Fast moving, fast attacking, smoke bomb
 * [b]Archangel[/b] - Ranged attack, AoE heal

As always you can edit them on the unit builder to see how they were created.

Cheers!

-----------

v1.05 - 21/12/2017

 * New Unit: Ninja - Fast moving, fast attacking, smoke bomb
 * New Unit: Archangel - Ranged attack, AoE heal
 
 * Added Default Anims Bare Hands
 * Added Default Anims: Dual Daggers
 * Animator: Adding new Body Part automatically selects correct Sprite
 * When Saving Unit Info a backup file is automatically saved

notes.title: Custom Sounds! - v1.04 - 19/12/2017
notes.content:
You can now add Custom Sounds to your Units! 
So you could add like a laser pistol sound on attack or a healing sound on a AoE Heal!

2 new really cool units being added on Thursday, stay tuned!

Cheers!

----------

v1.04 - 19/12/2017
 
 * Custom Sounds!
 
 * Added Code Action: Cycle through list
 * Added Code Action: Object Get Position
 * Added Code Action: Heal
 * Added Condition: Test List Count
 * Modified Code Action: Get Target List now supports targeting Friendlies
 * Code Action Parameter to Spawn Anim: Sprite Offset
 * Merged Code Actions for single objects and object lists
 * When building a Anim Type it now shows the Animation triggers
 * Fixed Shielder and Arrow icons in end battle screen

notes.title: Confetti! - v1.02a - 10/12/2017
notes.content:
v1.02 - 09/12/2017

 * Added End Battle button and screen with battle statistics and cofetti!
 * Added Start Battle button, now everything starts paused
 * Enemies no longer spawn inside map hitboxes
 * When opening Unit Builder you must first click Load or New
 * When entering Sandbox it now loads the previous Map Spawns
 * Select Option Window now appears on mouse position in Sandbox
 * Fixed Code Block param selecting it's Code Block
 * Fixed Select Option Window scrolling out of range
 * Fixed game crash if default folders were removed

 * Reduced Memory usage
 * Fixed crash when loading battle

notes.title: Massively reduced load times! - v1.01 - 06/12/2017
notes.content:
v1.01 - 06/12/2017

[b] * Massively reduced load times to almost nothing![/b]
 
 * Added Map Wilderness Small, good for testing
 * Added Code Action - Target Damage
 * Added Code Action - Target List Damage
 * Spartan and Ogre now cause damage on Knockback
 * Added "Duplicate Unit Spawn" button to Sandbox
 * Added button to Load Build Unit scene to Sandbox
 * Added Save As button to Build Unit Scene
 * Disabled upload default unit
 * Workshop showcase now filters default units
 * Workshop units are highlighted as such in Sandbox
